name: Flight Tracker
author: kairos
description: Shows nearby aircraft using free ADS-B data from opendata.adsb.fi

barWidget.description: Nearest aircraft or nearby aircraft count from opendata.adsb.fi

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: adsb.fi free tier - kept at 30s minimum.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Show a single aircraft (pick which one via 'Aircraft selection' below) or just a count of aircraft in range.

schema.label: Aircraft selection
schema.description: Which single aircraft to feature in the bar/tooltip when Bar display isn't 'count'. Applies instantly — no extra API calls.
